name: actionable-philosophy-book-club
description: Static SPA for philosophy book club meetings

scripts.build:vendor: terser node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js --compress --mangle -o dist/vendor/marked.min.js && cp node_modules/dompurify/dist/purify.min.js dist/vendor/
scripts.build:js: node scripts/inline-manifest.cjs && terser src/setup.js src/data-meeting.js src/data-repository.js src/_manifest.js src/path.js src/format.js src/storage.js src/utils.js src/retry.js src/asset-copy.js src/manifest.js src/viewer.js src/assets.js src/dashboard.js src/reader-links.js src/reader-loader.js src/view.js src/toast.js src/video-player.js src/asset-delegation.js src/onboarding.js src/theme.js src/routing.js src/app.js src/test-hooks.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o dist/app.js && terser src/theme-init.js --compress --mangle -o dist/theme-init.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && playwright test && bash tests/check-links.sh
